analysis: 11 月 23 日双足策略的实机观测离线推理与小腿跟踪复核
policy_identity: Operator confirms the 2026-09-16 model_50000 AMP-ROA; the running process SHA and FSM/inference captures were not saved.

recording.state_identification: First/last continuously nonzero wheel-velocity targets of the leg policy. Before/after: static/interpolated FSM command. No mode flag recorded.

method.input: 410 = 10 x 41 oldest to newest. Unnormalized hardware channels scaled/clipped exactly as deployment configuration, wheel relative positions zero. Project gravity via reference C++ inverse quaternion rotation. Built-in model transformations are internal.
method.first_step: First successful action gets zero last raw action and ten copies of the first observation. Phase starts at zero and advances after every successful output. Reconstructed clock assumes one output per published row.
method.one_step: Recover prior raw actions from preceding published position/velocity targets (invert the verified scale/default, no values at limits), also used in history. Current target is never used as an input or used in the 410-vector.
method.recursive: Carry only previous model-generated actions from the first policy frame. IMU, joint observations and velocity commands stay fixed to the bag, so this is an open-loop input replay, not a dynamic simulation.
method.correlation: Pearson correlation of predicted vs published target on identical frames. Position measures radians before conversion to degrees; wheel velocity uses rad/s.
method.side_difference: abs(right shank angle)-abs(left shank angle), degrees. Measured minus target difference equals left minus right shortfall in angle magnitude. This is a difference of averages, not a causal percentage.

counterfactuals.mirror_same_clock: Project LW leg convention, reflect body/command channels and swap-negate all five joint pairs for positions, velocities and prior actions throughout history, same global gait phase.
counterfactuals.mirror_half_cycle: Sensitivity only, also negate the two phase channels to swap the half cycle.
counterfactuals.zero_roll_gravity_and_x_gyro: Set projected gravity y=0, z=-hypot(y,z), keep gravity x, zero the body x gyroscope, hold all other measured histories fixed. Conditional single-step response only.

method.availability: No physical pressure, external velocity, measured drive gains, inference or source-snapshot frame IDs, raw deployed actions, firmware trace, or runtime model digest in this bag. Debug messages are a separately timed 50 Hz publication.
method.pd_check: The data publisher computes its own estimate with the configured gains. Agreement verifies the debug channel, not hardware-loop gains or a force measurement.

alignment.sampled_by: first forward bout, every third row (127 of 380), minimize RMS over eight position outputs; rest held out

frame_data.name: replay-frames.csv.gz
frame_data.feature_reconstruction: Repeat the first 41-value row to fill the initial history; then concatenate the preceding nine feature rows and current feature row. CSV of reconstructed features reflects the one-step pass.
